periods.time: Final morning of the Daien operation

name.zh: 刀华以雷切斩灭大炎残念
name.en: Toka destroys Daien's remnant with Raikiri

periods.location: Sky over Kyushu and Fukuoka storm clouds
periods.summary: After the Kyushu grid sends all available power into Toka, she becomes a lightning-like figure and launches upward with Takemikazuchi. Tendo's storm-remnant fires repeated Ame-no-Murakumo swords, but they shatter against the overwhelming collective energy. Toka tells Tendo that this is not divine grace but power entrusted by countless people: engineers, laborers, knights, mothers, children, and refugees all doing what they can. She rejects the need for a god's blessing and cuts through Tendo's God Breath and storm body with Raikiri, clearing Kyushu's sky.
periods.cause: Tendo persists after Moroboshi kills his body and tries to force another solitary Awakening by dropping twelve giant swords on Moroboshi and the repair crews.
periods.process: Toka receives grid power at Central Substation, escapes her death-chain vision through the image of everyone's lightning, and uses electromagnetic launch to fly into the clouds. Tendo mistakes her power for grace and rejoices, but she corrects him. He rejects her humanistic answer and unleashes God Breath; she answers with one amplified Raikiri.
periods.outcome: Tendo's remnant is erased, the storm and blizzard vanish, Kyushu is saved, and Tendo dies realizing his Excessive Awakening was not grace but a mistake born from failing to rely on others.
periods.significance: Climactic victory of the Daien arc; explicitly rejects solitary Desperado transcendence in favor of collective human strength.
